imapSecurityHelpText: 'IMAPS' connects using implicit TLS (port 993); 'STARTTLS' connects in plaintext and upgrades the connection, failing if the server does not offer it (port 143); 'None' never upgrades, even if the server offers STARTTLS - only use this against a trusted internal or test server.
imapMailboxTip: The mailbox to open, e.g. INBOX. Only used by the 'Authenticate + Select Mailbox' check type.
imapCheckTypeHelpText: 'Connect only' just reads the server's IMAP greeting. 'Authenticate' also logs in with the given credentials. 'Authenticate + Select Mailbox' additionally opens the configured mailbox - this is the most complete check and the default.
